name: @lenticule-science/l-space
description: L-Space: the Lenticule Science corpus application, routing admitted principals to VaultMaze or GEODE over CAIRN.

scripts.build:cloud: npm run build:engine && node --stack-size=65500 --import tsx scripts/build-cloud-release.mjs
scripts.build:worker: esbuild lib/cloudflare/src/worker.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/worker.mjs
scripts.build:vps: npm run build:cloud && npm run build:worker && esbuild lib/vps/authoring-entry.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/vps-authoring.mjs
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run build:cloud && npm run cloudflare:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply lenticule-science-vaultmaze --remote --config lib/cloudflare/wrangler.generated.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config lib/cloudflare/wrangler.generated.jsonc
